title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Vertica validateAdminConfig Remote Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Vertica.
